notes.title: Spooky Bonus Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/c3e40d4ca94d6f30563bb82bee0a840fbb64133f.png[/img]

We're delighted to announce that due to our recent game update, Valve has now given [b]Spooky Bonus[/b] an official Green Tick.

[b]What does it mean?[/b]
After each game is reviewed by Valve, it is categorized for its level of compatibility of Steam Deck. You’ll see these categories on Steam, when you’re browsing your library or shopping for games on Deck.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/0b183b1f3837b91d41b9a413e7eda9335b228896.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/9de433813dcb08289dbb72dbe3f6054fe28c7e55.png[/img][/url]
The green tick means not only is [b]Spooky Bonus[/b] playable on the Steam Deck, but it has been given the official seal of approval that it plays GREAT on Steam Deck! 

Enjoy! ːsteamthumbsupː
